summary: Records the first complete full-gate baseline and repairs ./dev editor-smoke. The W15 accessibility lane added a 'Selected on canvas' layer-row value, so two smoke assertions that expected an empty row value timed out; selection deliberately survives hiding and locking, so the driver gained a not-contains= condition and the two steps assert the state they toggle. No product code changed. Sixteen frozen commands pass with a clean tree: CTest 80/80, Python 328/328, ASan and UBSan 80/80, e2e, soak, shape fuzz 1000000 cases, mcp fuzz, viewer smoke, editor smoke, XML fuzz 30 s and animation fuzz 1000000 cases. Also records that ./dev fuzz-xml rewrites the pinned artifacts/WO-M2-03/pr-smoke.json, which a separate order fixes.
